in_hindi.name: चरुलाथा

in_tamil.name: சருலாதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who adorns temples with her presence, a temple attendant or a goddess

in_marathi.name: Charulatha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charulatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charu means 'radiant', and Latha means 'beauty'. Charulatha is a name inspired by the divine beauty and radiance of various Hindu goddesses.

in_bengali.name: Charulatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Radiant Beauty
in_bengali.long_meaning: Charulatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Charu means 'radiant', and Latha means 'beauty'. Charulatha is a name inspired by the divine beauty and radiance of various Hindu goddesses.
